angles.label: Question
angles.description: A recognisable question about the supplied pain.
angles.example: Where did the matching sock go?

angles.label: Complaint
angles.description: An everyday frustration expressed in natural spoken English.
angles.example: Laundry done. Matching socks still waiting.

angles.label: Pattern interrupt
angles.description: A surprising, clearly staged opening that introduces the same problem.
angles.example: A missing poster. For a sock.

angles.label: Personification
angles.description: Playful personification of a laundry object, not a literal product claim.
angles.example: My laundry basket has a sock collection.

angles.label: Story / POV
angles.description: A short relatable scene, not an invented customer testimonial.
angles.example: POV: laundry folded, loose socks still waiting.

angles.label: Curiosity
angles.description: An open loop that the unchanged reference body can honestly resolve.
angles.example: Take a closer look at these cuffs.

angles.label: Product / benefit
angles.description: A concrete product detail supported only by the verified facts.
angles.example: Small magnets on the cuffs. A closer look.

angles.label: Gift
angles.description: A gift-oriented creative framing without new packaging or delivery promises.
angles.example: A gift idea for laundry day.

angles.label: Visual contrast
angles.description: Contrast the supplied task and product, without inventing measured outcomes.
angles.example: The laundry problem. The product detail.

references.title: Laundry POV
references.script:
[0-3s] VO: Laundry folded. Loose socks still waiting.
ON-SCREEN: The unfinished task.
[3-8s] FRAME: A neat stack of laundry beside a few loose socks.
[8-15s] VO: SockLock pairs have small magnets on the cuffs.
[15-22s] FRAME: A close-up of the cuffs using the verified product appearance.
[22-30s] VO: Five pairs for $29, with a new delivery every quarter. Check the subscription details.

references.title: Missing-sock poster
references.script:
[0-3s] VO: A missing poster. For a sock.
ON-SCREEN: Last seen: laundry day.
[3-8s] FRAME: A clearly staged missing-sock poster beside a laundry basket.
[8-15s] VO: Take a closer look at SockLock and the small magnets on the cuffs.
[15-25s] FRAME: Show the actual product detail; no timed or guaranteed outcome.
[25-30s] VO: See the subscription details before you order.

references.title: Product close-up
references.script:
[0-3s] VO: Look closer at these cuffs.
ON-SCREEN: Small magnets.
[3-10s] FRAME: Close-up of a verified SockLock cuff and the magnet.
[10-20s] VO: The magnets hold a sock pair together.
[20-30s] VO: The subscription includes five pairs for $29 and a new delivery every quarter. Check the terms before you order.
